author: Inside Edition
description: A woman started a video diary detailing how she survived a vicious bear attack. Ariean Colton had just left her home in Alaska to go jogging when the beast struck. The mother of three was dragged 100 yards by the bear. Colton lost the vision in her left eye and in her video diary, says she underwent a 12-hour reconstructive surgery. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian spoke with Colton. She says she decided to make a video diary because she wants to be able to help people.
title: Woman Details Surviving Vicious Bear Attack In Video Diary

author: Inside Edition
description: Police in Philadelphia didn't have to travel far to investigate this incident. Officials say an SUV came crashing through the glass doors of a station, where the lobby was busy with people. Six people were reported injured, but from the looks of the surveillance video, it could have been a lot worse. Cops say the driver of the Hyundai Tucson was taken into custody after being released from the hospital. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 6 Injured When Man Crashes SUV Into Philadelphia Police Station

author: Inside Edition
description: Firefighters in northern Italy rescued a paraglider who was stuck in a tree. Footage of the unusual rescue was posted to social media by the Italian national firefighters’ association, the Vigili Dei Fuoco, said two departments from Ivrea and Turino had to go and pull the paraglider down who was dangling 26 feet from the ground. The paraglider seemed to have crashed into a farm leading one of the cows to go an inspect the situation.
title: Cows Watch As Firefighters Rescue Paraglider Stuck In Tree

author: Inside Edition
description: Robert McCaffrey is accused of the brutal murder of Lisa McBride in 1990. McBride's murder went unsolved for decades until advances in DNA testing led authorities to McCaffrey. McCaffrey has pled not guilty to murder charges.
title: Man Whose Wife Disappeared Accused Of Murdering Woman In 1990 #shorts
